finding.claim: Internal default-map lookup no longer goes through the public, overridable Context.lookup_default(), so custom Context subclasses overriding lookup_default() are ignored during normal parameter default resolution.
finding.evidence: Parameter.get_default() and Parameter.consume_value() were changed from ctx.lookup_default(...) to ctx._lookup_default(...). The new private helper is a concrete base-class implementation, while Command.make_context documents context_class customization and Parameter.get_default still documents the public lookup_default method.
finding.verification: Use a custom Context whose lookup_default returns an extension value, then resolve an option with no default. Base honors the override; the candidate calls the private helper and returns the internal unset sentinel.
